success_contract.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU from /app/isos/win311.img, with VNC on :1 (port 5901), nginx web access on port 80, snapshot mode to keep the image immutable, and programmatic keyboard input support; leave VM running in the background at the Windows 3.11 desktop.
required_artifacts: A runnable QEMU launch script or command in the visible workspace
A web interface served by nginx on port 80
A running QEMU process using /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode
Evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
Evidence that QEMU accepts programmatic keyboard input beyond VNC interaction
required_behaviors: QEMU listens on TCP port 5901 for VNC
nginx serves a web interface on port 80
Base disk image remains immutable via snapshot mode
Keyboard input can be injected programmatically into the VM
VM remains running in the background after startup
known_invalid_patterns: File existence without a running VM
Compilation or syntax checks without runtime evidence
Smoke checks that do not confirm VNC, nginx, desktop state, or keyboard injection
Claims of readiness without process/listener/probe evidence
verification_plan: Determine available QEMU/nginx tooling and image compatibility
Create or adapt a launch script that starts QEMU in snapshot mode with VNC :1 and keyboard-control plumbing
Start nginx web interface on port 80
Launch QEMU in background and verify listeners/processes
Use a programmatic keyboard injection path to confirm keystroke delivery
Confirm Windows 3.11 desktop state via VNC-visible evidence
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the launch command/script
Receipt-backed evidence of QEMU running in snapshot mode with /app/isos/win311.img
Receipt-backed evidence of VNC listening on port 5901
Receipt-backed evidence of nginx listening on port 80
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
Receipt-backed evidence of programmatic keyboard input capability

items: Inspect workspace and receipts for existing QEMU/nginx artifacts
Launch QEMU with snapshot mode and VNC :1
Probe VNC/web access and desktop state

model_notes.constraint: Need runtime evidence before finalization; do not rely on file existence alone.
